text: Wave Ω must clear an injected-hidden-HITL benchmark before admission; Adversary recall must materially exceed a single-Realist baseline.

First self-simulation (Wave γ) MUST include a discrimination test bench: ≥20 seeded sub-problems labeled {deserves-extraction / merely-hard}; report itch-filing precision/recall AND quality-delta at depth=0.
Every authored LOOP.md must carry a machine-readable typed `ports:` block; backfill into brainstorm/LOOP.md + cd-review/LOOP.md on first run.
Forged LOOP.md must declare its own canonical `last_step` vocabulary; loop-forge's kill-and-resume oracle runs against that vocabulary, NOT cd-review §10.7's step names.
Reverse-authority micro-cycle must NOT use a loop-spec.md tailored to the target's known capabilities; spec MUST be drawn from a fixed trivial-domain corpus declared in loop-forge's LOOP.md.
Cosine dedup threshold + canonical-promotion count must be tunable; LINEAGE BLOCK must enforce no-self-composition + no-parent-mutation invariants.
loop-forge MUST ship a built-in discrimination test bench gating primitive promotion (3/5 ideas independently require it).
loop-forge MUST carry a hard header-carried `remaining_extraction_depth` (default tunable, never unbounded) on every subagent dispatch.
loop-forge MUST use cd-review §0.5.4 day-status SHAPE as universal resume contract; each forged loop declares its own `last_step` vocabulary.
loop-forge's LINEAGE BLOCK MUST enforce no-self-composition + no-parent-mutation invariants.
